title: IDP Feature Manifest
description: feature.yaml — the declaration every installable IDP feature ships with.

featureId.description: Unique slug for the feature (DNS-safe). Used as S3 prefix and session-tag value.

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in the UI nav and feature page.

docsUrl.description: OSS features: a docs-site slug (e.g. 'extensions/sample-document-status') resolved against the published docs site for the UI 'Learn more' link. May also be an absolute https URL. Marketplace features omit this and fall back to marketplaceListingUrl.

showInNav.description: Whether this feature gets its own Extensions side-nav entry in the host UI while not yet installed. Set false for reference samples that should only be discoverable via Browse catalog. Installed features always appear in the nav regardless.

path.description: Path to the feature's CloudFormation template, relative to the project root.

requiresMainStackName.description: If true, the template must declare a MainStackName parameter.

not.description: buildCommand (legacy shell string) and build (structured steps) are mutually exclusive.

bundlePath.description: Path (relative to project root) to the built UMD bundle (ui-bundle.js).

buildCommand.description: DEPRECATED (runs through a shell — prefer `build`). Shell command run from project root to (re)build the bundle. Optional — if omitted and `build` is absent, the bundle is expected to already exist.

build.description: Structured build steps run in order to (re)build the bundle. Each step is executed WITHOUT a shell (argv exec), with an optional per-step working directory. Preferred over the legacy buildCommand string.

productCode.description: AWS Marketplace product code. Baked into the feature template and written to the host's InstalledFeatures row at install time, so the host's subscribe/entitlement resolvers find it without any per-host configuration.

listingUrl.description: Public Marketplace listing URL shown in the NONE/EXPIRED UI states. Flows to the InstalledFeatures row alongside productCode.

licenseMode.description: Which authority THIS EXTENSION enforces its subscription against. Baked into the feature template at publish time and forwarded to the host's registerFeature at install, so the host checks the same authority the extension honours instead of whatever the stack happens to be pointed at, and can flag a mismatch when its own catalog disagrees. Omitted means 'none' (enforce nothing): an extension that says nothing is not claiming to enforce anything, and an unrecognised value must never lock a paying customer out of something they bought. The host catalog's default is deliberately the opposite ('marketplace-live') so the host never over-claims verification. Extensions that already declare the mode elsewhere - e.g. a CloudFormation Mappings constant read by both their functions and their ui-deployer - should OMIT this and send licenseMode in the registerFeature payload directly rather than declaring the same fact twice; the host does not care where the value came from, only that it is in the payload.

pricingModel.description: Pricing model used when auto-seeding the marketplace simulator product on deploy. Defaults to 'free'.

apiName.description: Dimension API name (<= 15 chars, as required by the simulator / AWS Marketplace).

dimensions.description: Pricing dimensions used when auto-seeding the simulator product on deploy. Defaults to a single 'cap_units' dimension.

defaultParameters.description: CloudFormation parameters pre-filled on the Launch Stack URL. Values must be scalar.

capabilities.description: Capabilities the feature declares. Displayed on the FeaturePage as chips.

path.description: Path (relative to project root) to a YAML/JSON config preset uploaded to the feature bucket and applied to the host's ConfigurationTable at install time.

configPreset.description: Vertical-product packs (e.g. claims-pack) ship a config preset that becomes a new Config version in the host on install.

pipelineHooks.description: Map of pipeline hook point -> CloudFormation logical Lambda resource name in this template. The feature stack registers the resolved ARNs with the host via registerFeatureHooks at install time. `preprocessing` runs first (before BDA/pipeline routing) and `postprocessing` runs last (after evaluation); each is a standalone section holding a SINGLE hook, so only one feature can own it. The `post*` step points in between each hold a list of hooks.

packageCommand.description: DEPRECATED (runs through a shell — prefer `package`). Shell command (run from project root) to package the agent source zip.

package.description: Structured packaging steps run in order to produce the agent source zip. Each step is executed WITHOUT a shell (argv exec), with an optional per-step working directory. Preferred over the legacy packageCommand string.

artifactPath.description: Path (relative to project root) to the packaged agent-source.zip.

agentSource.description: Optional agent source packaging config. When present, the publisher runs the packaging steps (or legacy packageCommand) and uploads the resulting zip.

wrapperTemplatePath.description: Path (relative to project root) to the single-template deployment wrapper (deploy.yaml). publish-pack bakes the published artifact URLs into this template's parameter defaults and uploads the result.

hostTemplateUrlParam.description: Name of the wrapper parameter that takes the host accelerator template URL.

featureBucketParam.description: Name of the wrapper parameter that takes the S3 bucket holding the published feature artifacts. publish-pack bakes the publish bucket as this parameter's default; the wrapper passes it straight to the feature stack's FeatureBucket parameter (the feature stack reads artifacts in place via IAM — no seller-bucket copy).

prefixParam.description: Name of the wrapper parameter that takes the version-free artifact key prefix (e.g. 'extensions/<id>'). publish-pack bakes this as the parameter's default so the wrapper/feature stack can locate the published artifacts.

versionParam.description: Name of the wrapper parameter that takes the feature version. Defaults to '<FeatureIdCamel>Version'.

pack.description: Optional vertical-product pack config. When present, `idp-feature-cli publish-pack` produces a single-template deployment wrapper with all artifact URLs baked in as defaults, and `idp-feature-cli deploy-pack` deploys it with minimal arguments.

argv.description: Program + arguments, executed directly (no shell — no &&, |, globs, or variable expansion).

cwd.description: Working directory for this step, relative to the project root (replaces the `cd X && ...` shell idiom). Defaults to the project root.

commandSteps.description: Ordered list of subprocess steps run without a shell. Publishing aborts on the first non-zero exit.
